text_block_list.text:
"...Math homework is all set. Next is 
sports science, and... English, maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So sleepy~. But I ain't givin' up~. This 
weekend, I'm gonna spend all my time 
tinker-tinkering with my new gadgets~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go, Traaaaineeer. Freedom lies beyond 
the paperwork~."

Transcend ended up staying up late just to 
make time for her hobby...
